messages:
Maria (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the audit export + keystore onboarding playbook. Legal and security asked for more concrete launch criteria by EOW.
Leo (Eng): +1. Can we list the minimal acceptance criteria?
Anya (Security): From security's side: (1) tamper-evident export (integrity hashes), (2) per-tenant encryption keys (BYOK-compatible), (3) retention metadata preserved, (4) audit trail for access.
Sam (Legal): Also need e-discovery/hold toggle documented and export format that preserves chain-of-custody. Prefer a single canonical schema.
Vikram (SRE): Operationally: signed time-limited S3 URL for export, a job that writes to customer bucket or our staging bucket, and a verified checksum step. We need retries and idempotency.
Maria (PM): OK so MVP scope proposal: - export API that streams audit events (JSONL) + packaged manifest with SHA256 checksums - BYOK handshake for key wrapping only (no HSM onboarding in MVP) - per-tenant retention flag + region selector - downloadable evidence bundle (tar.gz) with manifest and .sig. Thoughts?
Leo (Eng): JSONL is simplest but parquet saves space. For early MVP we should do JSONL newline-delimited with gz compression. Parquet can be added later.
Anya (Security): Works. For tamper-evidence we do: generate SHA256 for each file, sign manifest with a service key, and allow customers to provide a wrapping key to encrypt the file key. We need to document verification steps.
Sam (Legal): That covers chain-of-custody. Also we need retention policy labels on each event: event.received_at, event.retention_bucket (e.g., SOC2_evidence_7y).
Vikram (SRE): Implementation note: exporter run steps: 1) snapshot events -> write tmp file -> compute hashes -> upload -> signal completion -> emit export_event to audit-log. Add exponential backoff for uploads.
Maria (PM): Draft launch criteria (must-have): 1) Export API + CLI to request export 2) Manifest with SHA256 + signed manifest 3) BYOK wrap/unwrapping handshake docs & test harness 4) Regional retention override + per-tenant config UI entrypoint 5) Legal-reviewed evidence packaging doc. Optional: Parquet, HSM/KMS auto-rotate.
Leo (Eng): ETA estimate: core export + manifest + CLI ~2 sprints. BYOK handshake + test harness ~1 sprint parallel. Ops hook (signed URLs, retries) should be small but needs infra review.
Anya (Security): Risk note: BYOK wrapping requires strict key handling docs. We should add an acceptance test: verify bundle verification end-to-end with customer-provided key.
Sam (Legal): Add one compliance checklist item: evidence retention durations per region (EU vs US) and legal-hold override. We should capture that in the playbook.
Maria (PM): Action items: @Leo owner for export API (due 2026-04-18), @Vikram owner for upload/ops hardening (due 2026-04-25), @Anya to author security verification runbook (due 2026-04-20), @Sam to draft legal-hold language (due 2026-04-20). I'll produce the launch criteria doc by EOW.
Leo (Eng): I'll spin up an RFC with sequence diagrams. Quick question: should manifest include per-file event counts? helps audit sampling.
Anya (Security): Yes include event_count and sha256 for each file, plus signature metadata: signer_id, signature_algo, signed_at.
Vikram (SRE): ops-bot: deploy-check for export-worker passed in staging?
ops-bot: staging export-worker healthcheck: OK. 3/3 replicas, avg CPU 18%, last export test OK.
Maria (PM): Great — last item: retention UI. MVP just a per-tenant toggle with dropdown (30d, 90d, 1y, 7y, custom via legal). We'll add more granular per-route retention later.
Sam (Legal): Fine, but flag that some customers will ask for immutable retention (write-once). We'll need to prepare a response and a roadmap item.
Leo (Eng): Noted. I'll mark parquet and immutable retention as follow-ups in the RFC.
Maria (PM): Thanks all. I'll post the launch criteria doc here when ready and tag owners.
Anya (Security): Will review the doc and add the verification checklist.
Vikram (SRE): I'll coordinate a smoke test with staging export-worker.
Sam (Legal): I'll sync with privacy counsel about region-specific retention language.
Maria (PM): End of thread — assigning PRIs now. :thumbsup:
